CREATE TABLE ultrabrain.fact_evidence (
 source_id text NOT NULL REFERENCES public.sources(id) ON DELETE CASCADE,
 fact_id bigint NOT NULL REFERENCES public.facts(id) ON DELETE CASCADE,
 revision integer NOT NULL CHECK(revision>0),state text NOT NULL CHECK(state IN ('bound','review_required')),
 fact_sha256 text NOT NULL CHECK(length(fact_sha256)=64),evidence_slug text NOT NULL,
 evidence_sha256 text NOT NULL CHECK(length(evidence_sha256)=64),page_id bigint NOT NULL,
 method text NOT NULL CHECK(method IN ('explicit','extraction')),updated_at timestamptz NOT NULL DEFAULT now(),
 PRIMARY KEY(source_id,fact_id))

CREATE TABLE ultrabrain.fact_evidence_events (
 source_id text NOT NULL,fact_id bigint NOT NULL,event_id text NOT NULL,revision integer NOT NULL,
 request_hash text NOT NULL,actor_key text NOT NULL,evidence_slug text NOT NULL,evidence_sha256 text NOT NULL,
 method text NOT NULL,created_at timestamptz NOT NULL DEFAULT now(),PRIMARY KEY(source_id,fact_id,event_id),
 FOREIGN KEY(source_id,fact_id) REFERENCES ultrabrain.fact_evidence ON DELETE CASCADE)

CREATE TRIGGER ultrabrain_fact_evidence_source_change AFTER INSERT OR UPDATE OR DELETE ON public.pages
 FOR EACH ROW EXECUTE FUNCTION ultrabrain.invalidate_fact_evidence_page()

CREATE FUNCTION ultrabrain.invalidate_fact_evidence_fact() RETURNS trigger LANGUAGE plpgsql SET search_path=pg_catalog,public AS $f$
BEGIN
 IF NEW.fact IS DISTINCT FROM OLD.fact OR NEW.source_id IS DISTINCT FROM OLD.source_id OR NEW.source IS DISTINCT FROM OLD.source
  OR NEW.kind IS DISTINCT FROM OLD.kind OR NEW.visibility IS DISTINCT FROM OLD.visibility OR NEW.context IS DISTINCT FROM OLD.context
  OR NEW.entity_slug IS DISTINCT FROM OLD.entity_slug OR NEW.source_session IS DISTINCT FROM OLD.source_session
  OR NEW.valid_from IS DISTINCT FROM OLD.valid_from OR NEW.valid_until IS DISTINCT FROM OLD.valid_until
  OR NEW.expired_at IS DISTINCT FROM OLD.expired_at OR NEW.superseded_by IS DISTINCT FROM OLD.superseded_by
  OR NEW.created_at IS DISTINCT FROM OLD.created_at THEN
  UPDATE ultrabrain.fact_evidence SET state='review_required',revision=revision+1,updated_at=now()
   WHERE source_id=OLD.source_id AND fact_id=OLD.id AND state='bound';
 END IF;
 RETURN NEW;
END $f$

CREATE TRIGGER ultrabrain_fact_evidence_native_change AFTER UPDATE ON public.facts
 FOR EACH ROW EXECUTE FUNCTION ultrabrain.invalidate_fact_evidence_fact()
